title.zh: ComfyUI 从零到第一条 H3 带声视频
title.en: ComfyUI zero to your first H3 video with audio

outcome.zh: 从空白 ComfyUI 环境出发，正确放置 5 个模型文件并生成一条画面、对白或环境声都能播放的 T2VA MP4。
outcome.en: Start with a clean ComfyUI setup, place all five model files correctly, and render a playable T2VA MP4 with picture and synchronized audio.

audience.zh: 第一次在 NVIDIA 电脑上本地运行 MiniMax H3、希望照着步骤完成而不是自己研究节点图的新手。
audience.en: First-time NVIDIA users who want a guided local MiniMax H3 run instead of reverse-engineering a node graph.

hardware.zh: Windows 或 Linux + NVIDIA GPU；先准备充足磁盘空间。显存不足时先用模板预览尺寸，不要一开始就跑 1344×768。
hardware.en: Windows or Linux with an NVIDIA GPU and ample disk space. Start at the template preview size when VRAM is limited instead of jumping to 1344×768.

zh: ComfyUI 0.30 或更新版本，能正常启动
NVIDIA 驱动与 ComfyUI 安装方式匹配；桌面版按官方安装器处理依赖
可访问模型文件，并为下载和输出预留空间
en: ComfyUI 0.30 or newer, starting without errors
NVIDIA drivers compatible with your ComfyUI installation; use the official installer for Desktop dependencies
Access to model files and enough disk space for downloads and outputs

zh: 安装或更新 ComfyUI。Windows 可用官方 Desktop/Portable；Linux 或手动安装使用独立 Python 环境。启动后先确认页面能打开，控制台没有 CUDA 初始化错误。
打开 Template Library → Video → MiniMax H3 T2V。若弹出模型下载窗口，直接按提示下载；若手动下载，必须保持原文件名。
把 minimax_h3_fl2va_pruned_int8_convrot.safetensors 放进 ComfyUI/models/diffusion_models/。T2V 与 I2V 都用 FL2VA；只有 R2V 才换成 Ref2VA 权重。
把 qwen3vl_32b_minimax_h3_nvfp4_awq.safetensors 放进 ComfyUI/models/text_encoders/；把 video VAE 和 audio VAE 一起放进 ComfyUI/models/vae/。缺少音频 VAE 时不能把静音结果当作成功。
把 minimax_h3_fl2v_turbo_8step_v1.0_comfyui_bf16.safetensors 放进 ComfyUI/models/loras/。它用于模板的可选 turbo_mode；第一次基线先关闭 Turbo，使用默认 20 步。
重启 ComfyUI 或刷新模型列表。逐个检查 Loader 下拉框能找到 diffusion model、text encoder、两个 VAE 与 LoRA；出现 null、undefined 或红色节点时先修路径，不要直接 Queue。
先用模板预览尺寸、16:9、multiple=32 和短时长生成。Prompt 先写完整场景，再写分镜/运镜，最后写对白、音效和音乐；先不要加自定义节点或多种加速器。
点击 Queue，等待 VAE 解码与视频封装完成。打开输出 MP4，分别检查画面、时长、声音和口型/事件同步，并保存这份工作流作为未修改的 baseline。
基线通过后再把分辨率提高到 H3 原生 1344×768，或在 Resolution Selector 选择 0.98 MP；不要选 1.0 MP，它会得到超过面积上限的 1376×768。
需要首尾帧时，在同一 FL2VA 工作流连接 first_frame/last_frame；需要人物、风格、动作或声音参考时，新建 R2V 模板并换成 Ref2VA 权重，不要在原图里混用两套模型。
en: Install or update ComfyUI. Use the official Desktop or Portable build on Windows, or a separate Python environment for a manual/Linux install. Confirm the UI opens without a CUDA initialization error.
Open Template Library → Video → MiniMax H3 T2V. Use the model-download popup when available; preserve the exact filenames for manual downloads.
Place minimax_h3_fl2va_pruned_int8_convrot.safetensors in ComfyUI/models/diffusion_models/. T2V and I2V use FL2VA; only R2V switches to Ref2VA weights.
Place qwen3vl_32b_minimax_h3_nvfp4_awq.safetensors in ComfyUI/models/text_encoders/. Put both the video and audio VAEs in ComfyUI/models/vae/. A silent render is not a successful audio-video setup.
Place minimax_h3_fl2v_turbo_8step_v1.0_comfyui_bf16.safetensors in ComfyUI/models/loras/. It powers the optional turbo_mode; keep Turbo off and use the default 20 steps for the first baseline.
Restart ComfyUI or refresh the model list. Confirm every Loader finds the diffusion model, text encoder, both VAEs, and LoRA. Fix null, undefined, or red nodes before queuing.

Render a short clip at the template preview size, 16:9, and multiple=32. Describe the scene first, then shots and camera, then dialogue, effects, or music. Add no custom nodes or stacked accelerators yet.
Queue the graph and wait through VAE decode and MP4 assembly. Open the file and verify picture, duration, audio, and event or lip synchronization. Save this untouched graph as the baseline.
After the baseline passes, move to the native 1344×768 canvas or 0.98 MP in Resolution Selector. Do not choose 1.0 MP because it produces 1376×768, above the model area cap.

For first/last frames, connect first_frame or last_frame in the same FL2VA graph. For identity, style, motion, camera, or voice references, open the R2V template and switch to Ref2VA weights instead of mixing model families.

zh: 5 个模型文件都能在对应节点中选中，没有红色缺失节点
20 步基线任务能完成，输出 MP4 可以站外播放器正常打开
视频含声音，且对白、环境声或音效与画面事件基本同步
已保存一份未叠加第三方节点的 baseline 工作流 JSON
en: All five model files appear in their matching nodes with no red missing nodes
The 20-step baseline finishes and its MP4 opens in an external player
The video contains audio and dialogue, ambience, or effects broadly align with picture events
An unmodified baseline workflow JSON is saved before adding third-party nodes

zh: 模型文件很大；磁盘空间、下载中断和文件放错目录是最常见的首次失败原因。
T2V/I2V 使用 FL2VA，R2V 使用 Ref2VA；权重混用会导致节点找不到模型或结果异常。
H3 分辨率需为 32 的倍数；高分辨率和长时长会显著增加显存与等待时间。
官方模板和文件名会更新；执行前用参考资料复核当前版本，不照抄过期截图。
en: Model files are large; storage, interrupted downloads, and wrong folders are the most common first-run failures.
T2V and I2V use FL2VA while R2V uses Ref2VA; mixing weight families causes missing models or bad output.
H3 resolutions must be multiples of 32, and higher resolution or duration sharply increases VRAM and wait time.
Templates and filenames evolve; verify the current reference before following an old screenshot.

expectedResult.zh: 生成一条可在普通播放器打开、包含同步声音的短 MP4，并保存一份未叠加第三方节点的 baseline 工作流。
expectedResult.en: Render a short MP4 with synchronized audio that opens in a regular player, and save an untouched baseline workflow before adding third-party nodes.

problem.en: A model is missing from a Loader

solution.zh: 核对五个文件的原始文件名与目录，刷新模型列表并彻底重启 ComfyUI。
solution.en: Check the original filename and folder for all five files, refresh the model list, and fully restart ComfyUI.

problem.zh: 输出静音或音画不同步
problem.en: The output is silent or out of sync

solution.zh: 确认 audio VAE 已加载，并先在不含第三方节点的 20 步短片上复现。
solution.en: Confirm the audio VAE is loaded and reproduce a short 20-step render without third-party nodes.

zh: 删除本教程新增的模型文件前先确认没有其他工作流引用。
保留 baseline JSON，出现兼容问题时退回官方模板。
en: Before deleting downloaded model files, confirm no other workflow references them.
Keep the baseline JSON and return to the official template when compatibility breaks.

materialsNote.en: Links lead to the original workflows, models or examples. Supply your own reference assets where needed. This generation workflow has not been independently run by this site.

recommendation.en: The native template gives a picture-and-audio baseline before introducing third-party nodes.

title.zh: 舰桥上的跃迁余震
title.en: After the Fleet Jumps

title.zh: Turbo + 低显存：把 20 步降到 4–8 步
title.en: Turbo + lower VRAM: reduce 20 steps to 4–8

outcome.zh: 在已经跑通的 H3 ComfyUI 基线上安装社区 Turbo 节点，用 6–8 步获得可用成片，并在爆显存时有明确降级顺序。
outcome.en: Add the community Turbo nodes to a working H3 ComfyUI baseline, render usable clips at 6–8 steps, and follow a controlled fallback order when VRAM runs out.

audience.zh: 已经能用官方 H3 工作流出片，但生成太慢或显存紧张的 NVIDIA 用户。
audience.en: NVIDIA users who can already render with the official H3 graph but need faster iteration or lower VRAM use.

hardware.zh: NVIDIA GPU；先记录原生工作流的峰值显存与耗时。低显存模式是兜底，不是默认画质选项。
hardware.en: An NVIDIA GPU. Record native peak VRAM and time first. Low-VRAM mode is a fallback, not the default quality setting.

zh: 第一条教程的原生 T2V 或 I2V 工作流已经稳定输出
固定 seed、Prompt、分辨率、时长和输入素材，便于 A/B 对比
ComfyUI-Manager 可用，或能手动安装 custom_nodes
从 Larryvrh 的 Hugging Face 仓库下载 minimax_h3_turbo_v4_step600_ema.safetensors
en: A stable native T2V or I2V workflow from the first guide
A fixed seed, prompt, resolution, duration, and input for A/B testing
ComfyUI-Manager or the ability to install custom_nodes manually
minimax_h3_turbo_v4_step600_ema.safetensors from Larryvrh's Hugging Face repository

zh: 先用原生 20 步工作流跑一次，记录总耗时、峰值显存、画面细节、快速运动和声音质量；这份结果是唯一基线。
在 ComfyUI-Manager 搜索 MiniMax-H3 Turbo 并安装；或在 ComfyUI/custom_nodes/ 克隆仓库。完成后彻底重启 ComfyUI，确认控制台没有导入错误。
把 minimax_h3_turbo_v4_step600_ema.safetensors 放入 ComfyUI/models/loras/。多数场景优先 v4-600；只有 4 步且高速大幅运动出现拖影时，才对比旧 v1-850。
从官方 T2V/I2V 图开始，在 Load Diffusion Model 与 SamplerCustomAdvanced 之间插入 MiniMax-H3 Turbo LoRA 节点，并选择刚放入的权重。
用 MiniMax-H3 Turbo Sampler 给 SamplerCustomAdvanced 提供 SAMPLER；BasicScheduler 设为 simple。其他 conditioning、双 VAE 解码和音频输出保持基线不变。
第一轮设 8 步、strength=1.0；成功后再试 6 步。4 步只用于快速构图预览或明确的低预算场景，不要默认把 4 步结果当最终质量。
用完全相同的 seed、Prompt、素材、分辨率和时长重新生成，比较耗时、脸手细节、快速运动拖影、音质与同步。一次只改 Turbo 这一个变量。
如果爆显存，先降低预览分辨率或时长，再关闭非必要预览/节点，最后才打开 low_vram。low_vram 会降低峰值显存，但量化输出可能更软。
如果画面拖影或模糊，可在明确问题片段把 strength 小幅提高到约 1.05–1.2；如果过锐和颗粒明显，降到约 0.8–0.95。每次只改一个参数。
保留原生与 Turbo 两份工作流。Turbo 用于选镜与批量预览，重要镜头仍与 20 步原生基线对比后再决定成片版本。
en: Run the native 20-step graph once and record total time, peak VRAM, fine detail, fast motion, and audio quality. This render is the only valid baseline.
Install MiniMax-H3 Turbo through ComfyUI-Manager, or clone it under ComfyUI/custom_nodes/. Fully restart ComfyUI and confirm there is no import error.
Place minimax_h3_turbo_v4_step600_ema.safetensors in ComfyUI/models/loras/. Prefer v4-600 for most work; compare the older v1-850 only when 4-step heavy motion shows trailing or smear.
Start from the official T2V or I2V graph. Insert MiniMax-H3 Turbo LoRA between Load Diffusion Model and SamplerCustomAdvanced, then select the downloaded checkpoint.
Feed SamplerCustomAdvanced from MiniMax-H3 Turbo Sampler and set BasicScheduler to simple. Keep conditioning, both VAE decoders, and audio output unchanged.
Start at 8 steps and strength=1.0, then test 6 steps. Use 4 steps for composition previews or strict budgets rather than assuming it is final quality.

Render again with the exact same seed, prompt, media, resolution, and duration. Compare time, face and hand detail, fast-motion trails, audio quality, and sync. Turbo must be the only changed variable.
If VRAM runs out, reduce preview resolution or duration first, disable nonessential previews or nodes second, and enable low_vram last. Low-VRAM mode lowers peak use but can soften quantized output.
For smear or blur on a specific clip, test strength around 1.05–1.2. For oversharp grain, test about 0.8–0.95. Change only one parameter per run.
Keep separate native and Turbo workflow files. Use Turbo for shot selection and bulk previews, then compare important finals against the native 20-step baseline.

zh: MiniMax-H3 Turbo LoRA 与 Turbo Sampler 两个节点都能搜索并加载
相同输入下，6–8 步 Turbo 成功输出带声 MP4
已保存原生与 Turbo 的耗时、峰值显存和质量对比
没有同时叠加 Spectrum、EasyCache 或其他未单独验证的加速器
en: Both MiniMax-H3 Turbo LoRA and Turbo Sampler nodes load successfully
The same input renders a video with audio at 6–8 Turbo steps
Native and Turbo time, peak VRAM, and quality comparisons are saved
Spectrum, EasyCache, and other untested accelerators are not stacked into this baseline

zh: 4–8 步是有效范围，6–8 步通常明显优于 4 步；超过 8 步不再带来稳定收益，还可能过锐。
strength 默认保持 1.0；只有具体片段出现拖影或过锐时才小幅调整。
low_vram 会以清晰度换显存，不要在显存足够时默认开启。
Turbo 的音质和高速运动仍在改进；不要把采样步数缩短直接宣传成等比例端到端加速。
不要把 Turbo、Spectrum、EasyCache 等全部叠加；优化器的误差与音频损失可能累积。
en: The useful range is 4–8 steps, with 6–8 usually much better than 4. Going above 8 adds no reliable benefit and may oversharpen.
Keep strength at 1.0 by default and tune only for a specific smear or oversharp failure.
low_vram trades sharpness for memory and should stay off when memory is sufficient.
Audio and intense fast motion remain active areas of improvement. Fewer sampling steps are not the same as proportional end-to-end speedup.
Do not stack Turbo, Spectrum, EasyCache, and other optimizers by default; their errors and audio losses can compound.

expectedResult.zh: 在相同 seed、输入、分辨率和时长下得到 6–8 步带声视频，并留下原生 20 步与 Turbo 的耗时和质量对照。
expectedResult.en: Render a 6–8 step video with audio from the same seed, input, resolution, and duration, with a native 20-step comparison saved beside it.

problem.zh: 新节点没有出现在搜索中
problem.en: The new nodes do not appear in search

solution.zh: 确认仓库位于 custom_nodes，查看启动日志中的导入错误并完全重启。
solution.en: Confirm the repository is under custom_nodes, inspect startup import errors, and fully restart.

problem.zh: 4 步画面拖影或声音变差
problem.en: Four-step output smears or loses audio quality

solution.zh: 先回到 8 步、strength 1.0；不要叠加 Spectrum 或 EasyCache。
solution.en: Return to eight steps at strength 1.0 and remove Spectrum or EasyCache from the comparison.

problem.zh: 参考音频触发张量尺寸错误
problem.en: Reference audio triggers a tensor-size mismatch

solution.zh: 先查看 Issue #27 与已合并的 PR #16，更新 Turbo 节点并完整重启。仍失败时回到不加 Turbo 的官方参考工作流；不要把 low_vram 开关当作已证实的修复。
solution.en: Check Issue #27 and merged PR #16, update the Turbo nodes and fully restart. If it persists, return to the official reference workflow without Turbo; low_vram is not an established fix.

problem.en: Out of VRAM: generation stops

solution.zh: 先降低分辨率与帧数，再按 Turbo README 开启 low_vram；量化基模合并 LoRA 后可能更软，应与原生基线比较。
solution.en: Reduce resolution and frame count, then enable low_vram as described in the Turbo README. Merging LoRA into a quantized base can soften output; compare against the native baseline.

zh: 删除 ComfyUI/custom_nodes/ComfyUI-MiniMax-H3-Turbo 并重启。
移除工作流中的 Turbo LoRA 与 Turbo Sampler 节点即可回到原生采样。
en: Delete ComfyUI/custom_nodes/ComfyUI-MiniMax-H3-Turbo and restart.
Remove the Turbo LoRA and Turbo Sampler nodes to restore native sampling.

applicableVersions: Larryvrh H3 Turbo · v4 step600 EMA
Native template Turbo and plugin Turbo use different setup paths

title.zh: Mac 从零运行 H3：纯 C + Metal
title.en: Run H3 on Mac from zero with pure C + Metal

outcome.zh: 不用 Python、PyTorch 或 ComfyUI，在 Apple Silicon 上编译 h3.c、检查模型，并生成第一条含声音的 MP4。
outcome.en: Without Python, PyTorch, or ComfyUI, compile h3.c on Apple Silicon, validate the model, and generate a first MP4 with audio.

audience.zh: 有 Apple Silicon Mac、能使用终端，但不想搭建 NVIDIA/ComfyUI 环境的用户。
audience.en: Apple Silicon users who can use Terminal and do not want to build an NVIDIA or ComfyUI stack.

hardware.zh: Apple Silicon Mac。作者常驻 BF16 路径的 DiT 约占 37 GiB，另需文本编码、VAE 和系统余量；内存不足时按 README 选 SSD streaming，不把 DiT 的占用当整机最低内存。先从 512×512、22 帧开始。
hardware.en: Apple Silicon Mac. The author’s resident BF16 DiT uses about 37 GiB, plus headroom for text encoding, VAEs and macOS. Use the README’s SSD-streaming path if memory is tight; DiT storage is not the minimum total system RAM. Start at 512×512 and 22 frames.

zh: macOS、Git 与 Xcode Command Line Tools
FFmpeg 和 FFprobe 可从终端直接调用
完整 MiniMax-H3 Hugging Face snapshot，目录名设为 MiniMax-H3
关闭占用大量统一内存的应用，并为首次载入预留足够时间
en: macOS, Git, and Xcode Command Line Tools
FFmpeg and FFprobe callable from Terminal
A complete MiniMax-H3 Hugging Face snapshot in a MiniMax-H3 directory
Memory-heavy applications closed and enough time reserved for the first load

zh: 打开终端运行 xcode-select --install；若已安装会提示无需重复。安装 Homebrew 后执行 brew install ffmpeg，再分别检查 ffmpeg 和 ffprobe 版本。
克隆 antirez/h3.c 并进入目录。不要把仓库和模型权重混在同一层散放：教程默认模型完整位于 ./MiniMax-H3。
从 Hugging Face 下载 MiniMaxAI/MiniMax-H3 的完整 snapshot 到 ./MiniMax-H3。下载完成后不要改权重文件名，也不要只下载 README 中看起来像主模型的单个文件。
执行 make -j8 编译；创建 outputs 目录。若编译失败，先确认当前终端使用的是 Apple clang，并重新检查 Command Line Tools，而不是随意删除编译参数。
运行 ./h3 --info -d ./MiniMax-H3。它只核验模型布局并打印 Metal 设备，不会映射全部权重或开始生成；任何缺失文件都应在这一步解决。
先运行 512×512、22 帧、20 步的平衡示例。首次启动包含模型载入与文件缓存，不能用第一次总耗时代表稳定速度。
只有终端支持图像预览时才添加 --show；内存紧张时省略它。用 --profile 记录各阶段耗时，勿把其他芯片的成绩当成本机保证。
确认 outputs/fox-fast.mp4 能播放且含声音。再以相同命令重复一次，第二次耗时才更适合与其他设置比较。
需要交互创作时运行 ./h3 -d ./MiniMax-H3 --width 512 --height 512 --steps 6。使用 !status、!seed random、!seconds 2 与 !save output.mp4 管理会话。
首尾帧使用 !first opening.png 与 !last ending.png；一般参考图使用 !ref-image person.png。Ref2VA 参考图不能和 !first/!last 同时使用，切换模式前先清理旧条件。
en: Run xcode-select --install in Terminal; macOS will say when it is already present. Install FFmpeg with Homebrew, then verify both ffmpeg and ffprobe.
Clone antirez/h3.c and enter the repository. Keep the code separate from the weight files; this guide expects the complete model at ./MiniMax-H3.
Download the complete MiniMaxAI/MiniMax-H3 Hugging Face snapshot into ./MiniMax-H3. Preserve filenames and do not download only the apparent main checkpoint.
Run make -j8, then create outputs. If compilation fails, confirm the active compiler is Apple clang and repair Command Line Tools before changing build flags.
Run ./h3 --info -d ./MiniMax-H3. It validates model layout and prints the Metal device without mapping every weight or generating media. Resolve missing files here.
Run the balanced 512×512, 22-frame, 20-step example first. The first invocation pays model-loading and filesystem-cache costs, so its total time is not a stable benchmark.
Add --show only in a terminal that supports image previews; omit it under memory pressure. Use --profile for phase timings and do not treat results from another chip as a guarantee.
Confirm outputs/fox-fast.mp4 plays with audio. Repeat the same command; the second run is a more useful performance comparison.
For interactive work, run ./h3 -d ./MiniMax-H3 --width 512 --height 512 --steps 6. Use !status, !seed random, !seconds 2, and !save output.mp4 to control the session.
Use !first opening.png and !last ending.png for boundary frames, or !ref-image person.png for a general reference. Ref2VA references cannot be mixed with !first or !last; clear the old mode first.

zh: 先有可播放的 H3 基线工作流
当前主线使用 ComfyUI 0.34+；旧环境按 CHANGELOG 选择 v0.3.1
为中间 latent 和视频输出预留磁盘空间
en: A working H3 baseline with playable output
Use ComfyUI 0.34+ for the current main branch; select v0.3.1 for older environments as described in CHANGELOG
Disk space for intermediate latents and output videos

zh: 先检查 ComfyUI 版本并安装兼容的 Motion Context；重启后确认节点注册，首次生成时检查 layout checks 日志。
复制基线或打开示例 JSON，把 Motion Context 接到 conditioning 路径；Save Latent 接采样器输出，Load Latent 接 context_latent。
把 Load、Save 和 Chain 放进同一个画布分组。第一段设 Load=0、Save=1；Load=0 不读文件，可让第一段直接通过。
使用 Chain 节点的 Run/Re-roll 生成第一段。检查输出后，满意再 Approve；它会同时推进索引并排队下一段。
第二段沿用相同尺寸，用前一段结尾的构图和动作开始新 Prompt。不要一开始就换场景，以免难以判断续接问题。
让解码后的 IMAGE 与 AUDIO 一起经过 Trim，并接入 trim_frames；输出会裁去用于衔接的重叠头部。
播放拼接点，分别检查重复帧、运动方向、静帧和声音重启。通过后再扩展第三段，并保存工作流与片段索引。
en: Check the ComfyUI version and install compatible Motion Context. After restarting, confirm node registration and inspect layout checks on first use.
Duplicate the baseline or open the example JSON. Put Motion Context in the conditioning path, Save Latent after the sampler, and Load Latent into context_latent.
Place Load, Save and Chain in one canvas group. For clip one use Load=0 and Save=1; Load=0 reads no file and passes the first clip through.
Generate clip one with the Chain node Run/Re-roll control. Inspect it, then use Approve to advance both indices and queue the next clip.
Keep the same dimensions for clip two and begin its prompt with the preceding composition and motion. Avoid an immediate location change while evaluating continuity.
Pass decoded IMAGE and AUDIO through Trim and connect trim_frames. It removes the overlapping head used for continuity.
Play across the join and inspect repeated frames, motion direction, freezes and restarted sound. Extend to clip three only after checking the join, and save the workflow and indices.

zh: Load、Save 与 Chain 在同一组；索引与实际片段一致。
Trim 同时处理画面和声音，没有重复的衔接头部。
拼接点经过视听检查；不能仅凭脚本执行完毕宣称连续。
en: Load, Save and Chain share a group and indices match the actual clips.
Trim handles both picture and sound without a repeated overlap head.
The join has been watched and listened to; successful execution alone does not prove continuity.

zh: 不要用 queue run on change 推进链条；索引修改可能触发重复排队。
软件布局检查失败时先看版本说明，不能把测试通过等同于生成效果通过。
en: Do not advance a chain with queue run on change; index changes can trigger duplicate runs.
If layout checks fail, consult compatibility notes. Passing code tests does not prove output quality.

expectedResult.zh: 第二段延续第一段的运动方向与声音，并在 Trim 后移除重复上下文；两段分辨率一致、接缝可检查。
expectedResult.en: Clip B continues clip A's motion direction and sound, duplicate context is removed after Trim, and both clips share one resolution with an inspectable join.

problem.zh: Load Latent 形成循环连接
problem.en: Load Latent creates a circular graph

solution.zh: 使用插件自带的 Save/Load Latent 跨运行传递，并明确设置上一段与当前段的 clip_index。
solution.en: Use the pack's Save/Load Latent nodes across runs and set the previous/current clip_index explicitly.

problem.en: The join repeats or audio drifts

solution.zh: 把 trim_frames 接到 Motion Context Trim，保持 match_tail，并从 22 帧视频、24 帧音频上下文重新测试。
solution.en: Wire trim_frames into Motion Context Trim, keep match_tail enabled, and retry with 22 video and 24 audio context frames.

zh: 删除 ComfyUI/custom_nodes/ComfyUI-H3-Motion-Context 并重启。
移除 Motion Context、Save/Load Latent 与 Trim 节点后恢复普通 H3 图。
en: Delete ComfyUI/custom_nodes/ComfyUI-H3-Motion-Context and restart.
Remove Motion Context, Save/Load Latent, and Trim nodes to restore a standard H3 graph.

zh: 打开 R2V 模板，确认模型切换到 Ref2VA；不要继续使用 T2V/I2V 的 FL2VA 权重。
按模板连接参考图、视频和音频，记下输入顺序；第一次只保留任务必需的少量素材。
对照官方参考指南声明各素材的任务：身份、动作、背景或声音；明确保留和修改的部分。
在同一短场景里安排一句对白，按官方格式标出说话人和语言；检查所有引用都对应已上传素材。
生成后分别检查人物特征、动作、台词与声音。人物不稳先减少互相冲突的参考，台词不完整先缩短对白。
基线满意后再尝试改变机位或动作，并写清哪些内容保持不变；不要同时替换所有参考。
en: Open the R2V template and select Ref2VA instead of the FL2VA weights used for T2V/I2V.
Connect image, video and audio references as shown in the template and record their input order. Start with only the assets the task requires.
Use the reference guide to assign identity, action, background or sound roles and specify what should be retained or changed.
Place one spoken line in a short scene, with the official speaker and language format. Check that every reference corresponds to an uploaded input.
Inspect identity, motion, dialogue and sound separately. Reduce conflicting references for unstable identity and shorten incomplete dialogue.
Once the baseline is satisfactory, try a camera or action change while specifying what stays the same. Do not replace all references at once.

zh: 不要声称像素级复刻；快速运动和遮挡仍可能漂移。
en: Do not expect pixel-level reconstruction; fast motion and occlusion can still drift.

zh: 先确认官方 H3 ComfyUI 基线可以输出带声 MP4，并保存固定 seed、Prompt、画布、帧数和 20 步结果。
在 ComfyUI Manager 搜索 MiniMax H3 Audio T8，或用 comfy CLI 安装；完成后彻底重启 ComfyUI。
打开 examples/workflows/01-basic-generation，替换成自己的模型与素材；首轮使用 22 帧、小画布和 stock sampler。
先接 MiniMaxH3AudioConditioningT8、MiniMaxH3DualClockSamplerT8、MiniMaxH3AVDecodeT8 和 MiniMaxH3PreflightT8，运行预检并修复尺寸、标签或显存错误。
固定视频步数，只改变音频时钟；再固定音频步数，只改变视频时钟。每次记录总耗时、声音清晰度、事件同步和输出轨道信息。
只有稳定链路通过后才加入 Turbo LoRA；实验节点、SageAttention 和长视频链路分开验证，不在第一轮叠加。
en: Confirm the official H3 ComfyUI baseline outputs an MP4 with audio, then save its seed, prompt, canvas, frame count, and 20-step result.
Find MiniMax H3 Audio T8 in ComfyUI Manager or install it with the comfy CLI, then fully restart ComfyUI.
Open examples/workflows/01-basic-generation and replace the models and media. Start with 22 frames, a small canvas, and the stock sampler.
Wire MiniMaxH3AudioConditioningT8, MiniMaxH3DualClockSamplerT8, MiniMaxH3AVDecodeT8, and MiniMaxH3PreflightT8 first. Run preflight and fix size, tag, or VRAM errors.
Hold video steps constant while changing the audio clock, then reverse the test. Record total time, speech clarity, event sync, and output stream metadata each time.
Add Turbo LoRA only after the stable path passes. Test experimental nodes, SageAttention, and long-video graphs separately rather than stacking them in the first run.

hardware.zh: 生成需求由 H3 与所选工作流决定，插件本身主要编译提示词。作者在投稿中报告 Linux + NVIDIA H200 141GB 生成 8 秒约需 30 分钟；这不是最低配置，也不是本站实测。其他显卡耗时未知。
hardware.en: Rendering requirements come from H3 and the selected workflow; the plugin primarily compiles prompts. In the submission, the author reports roughly 30 minutes for 8 seconds on Linux with an NVIDIA H200 141GB. This is neither a minimum requirement nor a site benchmark; other GPUs were not timed.

zh: 先跑通 ComfyUI 官方 H3 模板；若尚未成功，先阅读本站 ComfyUI 入门路线。
使用 ComfyUI 0.31.0 或更新版本，Python 3.10 或更新版本。
准备 Comfy-Org/MiniMax-H3 的四个权重，保留原始文件名。作者 2026-09-02 统计约 39.6 GiB，另留输出与运行空间。
en: Render one clip with the official ComfyUI H3 template first; use our ComfyUI setup guide if needed.
Use ComfyUI 0.31.0 or newer and Python 3.10 or newer.
Obtain the four Comfy-Org/MiniMax-H3 weights without renaming them. The author's September 2 snapshot totals about 39.6 GiB; allow additional space for outputs and runtime files.

zh: 在 ComfyUI/custom_nodes 下执行下方克隆命令，然后重启 ComfyUI。
将 minimax_h3_ref2va_pruned_int8_convrot.safetensors 放入 ComfyUI/models/diffusion_models/。
将 qwen3vl_32b_minimax_h3_nvfp4_awq.safetensors 放入 ComfyUI/models/text_encoders/；将 minimax_h3_video_vae_fp16.safetensors 和 minimax_h3_audio_vae_fp32.safetensors 放入 ComfyUI/models/vae/。
打开 Workflow → Browse Templates → minimax-director；也可拖入插件的 example_workflows/minimax-director.json。先确认所有加载器都选中了正确文件，保持 Turbo 与 Upscale 关闭。
选中播放头下的镜头块，填写该镜头的画面、运镜和声音；在时间轴安排后续镜头。时长会自动对齐 H3 允许的帧数。
在 WHO & WHAT 为重复出现的人物或物体建立卡片，添加参考素材与描述；点击镜头 SUBJECTS 行的卡片，将 <Subject n> 插入镜头文本。
检查 Prompt 面板的实际模型输入与 Report 面板的问题。修正明确报错后 Queue；查看输出 MP4 的画面、片长与声音。
需要快速预览时，再准备作者文档中的 4-step Turbo LoRA，放入 models/loras/ 并开启 Speed 组的 Turbo。使用配套 4 步、强度 1.0 和 simple 调度；声音或快速动作变差时关闭 Turbo 回到普通生成。
en: Run the clone command below from ComfyUI/custom_nodes, then restart ComfyUI.
Place minimax_h3_ref2va_pruned_int8_convrot.safetensors in ComfyUI/models/diffusion_models/.
Place qwen3vl_32b_minimax_h3_nvfp4_awq.safetensors in ComfyUI/models/text_encoders/. Put minimax_h3_video_vae_fp16.safetensors and minimax_h3_audio_vae_fp32.safetensors in ComfyUI/models/vae/.
Open Workflow → Browse Templates → minimax-director, or drag in the plugin's example_workflows/minimax-director.json. Check every loader and leave Turbo and Upscale off initially.
Select the shot block under the playhead and describe its picture, camera movement and sound. Arrange subsequent shots on the timeline; duration snaps to an accepted H3 frame count.
Create WHO & WHAT cards for recurring people or objects with reference assets and descriptions. Click a card in the shot's SUBJECTS row to insert <Subject n> into the shot text.
Inspect the actual model input in Prompt and resolve explicit errors in Report before queueing. Check the resulting MP4 for picture, duration and sound.

For a faster preview, obtain the author's documented 4-step Turbo LoRA, place it in models/loras/ and enable Turbo in Speed. Use its matching four steps, strength 1.0 and simple scheduler. Disable Turbo if sound or fast motion deteriorates.

zh: 加载器能找到四个权重，Prompt 有内容，Report 没有阻断错误。
生成的 MP4 能播放，片长符合时间轴，画面和声音均存在；自行核对对白同步与角色一致性。
en: All four weights resolve, Prompt contains the compiled input, and Report has no blocking errors.
The MP4 plays with the expected duration, picture and sound. Inspect dialogue synchronization and subject consistency yourself.

zh: 24 fps 下 H3 帧数满足 length % 17 == 5；编辑器会对齐时长，不等于可以无限续长。
角色参考与对白编译不能保证每次生成都保持人物一致或精准口型。
4-step Turbo 是预览方案，作者提示其音频与快速运动效果有局限。
Upscale 默认关闭；开启前还需作者文档指定的上采样节点和权重，会增加计算量。
en: At 24 fps, accepted H3 lengths satisfy length % 17 == 5. Timeline snapping does not enable unlimited duration.
Reference cards and dialogue compilation cannot guarantee subject consistency or perfect lip sync in every generation.
The four-step Turbo path is a preview option with author-reported audio and fast-motion limitations.
Upscale is off by default. Enabling it requires the extra node pack and weights in the author's instructions and adds computation.

recommendation.zh: 作者把安装、完整工作流、镜头编辑和排错整理成一套教程，适合从单镜头跨到多镜头；包含英文演示及中文配音入口。
recommendation.en: The author provides installation, a complete graph, shot editing and troubleshooting in one tutorial, with an English walkthrough and a Chinese dub.

cost.zh: 开源插件无需另购服务；实际视频生成仍消耗本地或云 GPU 算力，本站未购买算力复现实测。
cost.en: The open-source plugin requires no separate service purchase. Rendering consumes local or rented GPU resources; we have not paid for a generation test.

label.zh: 四个 H3 权重文件

expectedResult.zh: 获得通过检查的多镜头 Prompt 和一段有声视频；实际画质、声音和角色连续性需观看结果判断。
expectedResult.en: A validated multi-shot prompt and a video with sound; inspect the output to judge image quality, audio and character continuity.

problem.en: Cannot find the example workflow

solution.zh: 当前路径为 example_workflows/minimax-director.json；旧投稿中的 examples/ 已过时，也可从 Browse Templates 打开。
solution.en: Use example_workflows/minimax-director.json or Browse Templates. The examples/ path in the initial submission is outdated.

problem.en: Empty weight dropdown

solution.zh: 核对原始文件名和上述目录，刷新模型列表或重启；空下拉也可能是文件尚未下载完成。
solution.en: Check original filenames and the directories above, then refresh or restart. Also confirm the download completed.

problem.zh: Turbo 画面正常但音频失真
problem.en: Turbo picture looks fine but audio is distorted

solution.zh: 确认 ComfyUI >= 0.31.0 并提供 ModelSamplingAV；仍有问题先关闭 Turbo，作者也提示 4-step 音频有限制。
solution.en: Confirm ComfyUI >= 0.31.0 with ModelSamplingAV. Disable Turbo if the problem persists; the author also notes four-step audio limitations.

zh: 先保存自己的工作流与素材。停止 ComfyUI，将 custom_nodes/ComfyUI-MiniMaxDirector 移出节点目录或移到废纸篓，再重启。
H3 权重仍在 ComfyUI/models/，移除插件不会自动删除它们。
en: Save your workflows and assets first. Stop ComfyUI, move custom_nodes/ComfyUI-MiniMaxDirector out of the node directory or to Trash, then restart.
H3 weights remain under ComfyUI/models/; removing the plugin does not remove them.
